// src/admin.ts
export type AdminId = string & {
    readonly __brand: "AdminId";
};
export type Email = string & {
    readonly __brand: "Email";
};
export type Admin = {
    id: AdminId;
    email: Email;
    passwordHash: string | null;
    identitySubject: string | null;
    createdAt: Date;
};
export declare const minimumPasswordLength = 12;
export declare function parseEmail(raw: string): Email | null;
export declare function isAcceptablePassword(password: string): boolean;
// src/calendar.ts
export type LocalDate = string & {
    readonly __brand: "LocalDate";
};
export type LocalTime = string & {
    readonly __brand: "LocalTime";
};
export declare function localDateTime(at: Date, timeZone: string): {
    date: LocalDate;
    time: LocalTime;
};
export declare function addDays(date: LocalDate, days: number): LocalDate;
export declare function daysBetween(from: LocalDate, to: LocalDate): number;
export declare function isLocalDate(value: string): value is LocalDate;
// src/family-member.ts
import type { Photo } from "./photo";
export type FamilyMemberId = string & {
    readonly __brand: "FamilyMemberId";
};
export type FamilyMember = {
    id: FamilyMemberId;
    name: string;
    photo: Photo | null;
    createdAt: Date;
};
export declare const maximumNameLength = 40;
export declare function parseName(raw: string): string | null;
export declare function initialOf(name: string): string;
// src/photo.ts
export type BlobRef = string & {
    readonly __brand: "BlobRef";
};
export declare const photoTypes: readonly ["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp", "image/gif"];
export type PhotoType = (typeof photoTypes)[number];
export type Photo = {
    blob: BlobRef;
    contentType: PhotoType;
};
export declare const maximumPhotoBytes: number;
export declare function photoTypeOf(file: Uint8Array): PhotoType | null;
// src/source.ts
export type SourceTypeId = string & {
    readonly __brand: "SourceTypeId";
};
export type SourceId = string & {
    readonly __brand: "SourceId";
};
export type SourceAttributeId = string & {
    readonly __brand: "SourceAttributeId";
};
export type SourceStatus = "ok" | "failing" | "silent";
export type RunError = {
    kind: "definite" | "temporary";
    message: string;
};
export type SourceFailure = RunError & {
    since: Date;
};
export declare const failingAfterMs: number;
export declare const silentAfterMs: number;
export declare function sourceStatus(source: {
    failure: SourceFailure | null;
    silentApplies: boolean;
    lastNewRecordAt: Date | null;
    createdAt: Date;
    now: Date;
}): SourceStatus;
// src/agenda.ts

    readonly __brand: "AgendaId";
};

export declare function isAgendaLayout(value: string): value is AgendaLayout;
export type Agenda = {
    id: AgendaId;
    layout: AgendaLayout;

    createdAt: Date;
};

    min: number;
    max: number;
};

// src/item.ts
export type ItemId = string & {
    readonly __brand: "ItemId";
};

    readonly __brand: "OriginId";
};

    readonly __brand: "RawMessageId";
};

    fields: Record<string, unknown>;

};
// src/event.ts
import { type LocalDate, type LocalTime } from "./calendar";
import type { ItemFields } from "./item";
export type TimeSpan = {
    allDay: false;
    start: Date;
    end: Date;
} | {
    allDay: true;
    firstDay: LocalDate;
    lastDay: LocalDate;
};
export type Event = {
    title: string;
    span: TimeSpan;
    place: string | null;
    cancelled: boolean;
};
export declare const maximumEventTextLength = 500;
export declare function problemsWithEventFields(fields: Record<string, unknown>): string[];
export declare function eventOf(folded: ItemFields | null): Event | null;
export declare function spanOnDay(span: TimeSpan, day: LocalDate, timeZone: string): {
    from: LocalTime | null;
    until: LocalTime | null;
} | null;
export declare function lastDayOf(span: TimeSpan, timeZone: string): LocalDate;
export declare function spanBounds(span: TimeSpan): {
    from: Date;
    to: Date;
};
// src/lesson.ts
import type { ItemFields } from "./item";
export type LessonSpan = {
    start: Date;
    end: Date;
};
export type Lesson = {
    subject: string;
    span: LessonSpan;
    room: string | null;
    teacher: string | null;
    cancelled: boolean;
};
export declare const timetableChangeKinds: readonly ["cancellation", "substitution", "room-change"];
export type TimetableChangeKind = (typeof timetableChangeKinds)[number];
export type TimetableChange = {
    change: TimetableChangeKind;
    subject: string;
    span: LessonSpan;
    room: string | null;
    teacher: string | null;
    previousRoom: string | null;
    previousTeacher: string | null;
    note: string | null;
};
export declare const maximumLessonTextLength = 200;
export declare function problemsWithLessonFields(fields: Record<string, unknown>): string[];
export declare function lessonOf(folded: ItemFields | null): Lesson | null;
export declare function timetableChangeOf(folded: ItemFields | null): TimetableChange | null;
// src/task.ts
import { type LocalDate } from "./calendar";
import type { ItemFields } from "./item";
export type Task = {
    title: string;
    deadline: LocalDate | null;
    bring: string[];
    doneAt: Date | null;
    arrivedAt: Date | null;
    cancelled: boolean;
};
export type TaskStatus = "upcoming" | "due" | "overdue" | "done";
export declare const maximumTaskTextLength = 500;
export declare const maximumThingsToBring = 50;
export declare function problemsWithTaskFields(fields: Record<string, unknown>): string[];
export type StatedTask = Pick<Task, "title" | "deadline" | "bring" | "cancelled">;
export declare function taskOf(folded: ItemFields | null): StatedTask | null;
export declare function taskStatus(task: Task, today: LocalDate): TaskStatus;
export declare function isPinned(task: Task, today: LocalDate): boolean;
export declare function instantOfTask(task: Task): Date | null;
export declare function dayOfTask(task: Task, timeZone: string): LocalDate | null;
export declare function isOutstanding(task: Task): boolean;
// src/mention.ts
import { type LocalDate } from "./calendar";
export declare const weekdays: readonly ["monday", "tuesday", "wednesday", "thursday", "friday", "saturday", "sunday"];
export type Weekday = (typeof weekdays)[number];
export type DateMention = {
    day: number | null;
    month: number | null;
    year: number | null;
    weekday: Weekday | null;
    daysAfter: number | null;
    weeksAfter: number | null;
};
export type ResolvedDate = {
    ok: true;
    date: LocalDate;
} | {
    ok: false;
    problem: "weekday-mismatch";
    date: LocalDate;
} | {
    ok: false;
    problem: "no-date";
};
export declare function resolveDate(mention: DateMention, sentOn: LocalDate): ResolvedDate;
export declare function resolveDeadline(mention: DateMention, sentOn: LocalDate): ResolvedDate;
export declare function instantAt(date: LocalDate, time: string, timeZone: string): Date | null;
export declare function quoteFoundIn(quote: string, message: string): boolean;
export declare function weekdayOf(date: LocalDate): Weekday;
// src/network.ts
export declare function isLocalHost(host: string): boolean;
// src/language.ts
export declare const familyLanguages: readonly ["en", "de"];
export type FamilyLanguage = (typeof familyLanguages)[number];
export declare const defaultFamilyLanguage: FamilyLanguage;
export declare function isFamilyLanguage(text: string): text is FamilyLanguage;
export declare function localeOf(language: FamilyLanguage): string;
export type OcrLanguage = string & {
    readonly __brand: "OcrLanguage";
};
export declare function isOcrLanguage(text: string): text is OcrLanguage;
export declare function ocrLanguageOf(language: FamilyLanguage): OcrLanguage;
export type FamilyLanguages = {
    language: FamilyLanguage;
    ocrLanguages: OcrLanguage[];
};
export type MultilingualText = string | {
    en: string;
    [language: string]: string | undefined;
};
export declare function textIn(text: MultilingualText, language: FamilyLanguage): string;
